name: 原子：种草链路 - 审核任务备注(任务类型标签)显示验证
description: 进入审核任务详情页，验证任务列表包含'备注'列，种草任务的备注值显示'新增F0'（任务类型标签），进入审核详情后SetImageReview组件的备注字段同样显示该值。

steps._comment: ===== 找到种草审核任务并进入详情 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('种草') && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, taskText: t.slice(0, 80) }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 找到种草审核任务并进入详情
断言种草审核任务存在

steps._comment: ===== 验证任务列表表头含'备注'列 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent?.trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasRemark = headers.some(h => h.includes('备注')); return { headers, hasRemark }; })()
steps.description: 读取任务列表表头，检查备注列

steps._comment: ===== 验证种草任务的备注值 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')); const remarkIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.textContent?.includes('备注')); if (remarkIdx < 0) return { found: false, reason: 'no remark column' }; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, tr')); const remarkValues = []; for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length > remarkIdx) { const val = cells[remarkIdx]?.textContent?.trim(); if (val) remarkValues.push(val); } } return { found: true, remarkIdx, remarkValues }; })()

(() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')); const remarkIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.textContent?.includes('备注')); if (remarkIdx < 0) return { hasF0: false }; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, tr')); for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length > remarkIdx) { const val = cells[remarkIdx]?.textContent?.trim(); if (val && (val.includes('F0') || val.includes('新增'))) return { hasF0: true, value: val }; } } return { hasF0: false }; })()
steps.description: 检查备注列是否包含F0标签
断言备注列显示F0相关标签（如'新增F0'）

steps._comment: ===== 进入审核详情验证备注字段 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 验证审核详情中的备注字段 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const labels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=label]')); const remarkLabel = labels.find(l => l.textContent?.trim()?.includes('备注')); if (!remarkLabel) return { found: false }; const parent = remarkLabel.closest('[class*=field]') || remarkLabel.parentElement; const value = parent ? parent.querySelector('[class*=value]') : null; const remarkText = value ? value.textContent?.trim() : ''; return { found: true, labelText: remarkLabel.textContent?.trim(), remarkText, valueCls: value?.className?.slice(0, 60) || '' }; })()
steps.description: 读取审核详情中的备注字段
断言审核详情中备注字段存在

steps.expression: (() => { const remarkEl = document.querySelector('[class*=remark]'); return { exists: !!remarkEl, text: remarkEl?.textContent?.trim() || '', cls: remarkEl?.className?.slice(0, 60) || '' }; })()
steps.description: 通过remark class直接查找备注值

steps.label: seeding-task-type-label-detail
steps.description: 截图-审核详情备注字段

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心存在种草审核任务
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 任务列表表头含'备注'列（第7列）；种草任务备注值='新增F0'；审核详情SetImageReview组件左侧信息面板含'备注:'标签，值显示在.SetImageReview--value--*.SetImageReview--remark--*元素中
riskPoints: 备注值可能随任务类型不同：F0/F0爆款&潜爆/其他
种草审核任务可能不存在（需通过试运行构造数据）
备注列位置可能随表格列变更
